items.label: Verify fundraiser
items.description: Approve this fundraiser and post the r/IndianPets mod team verification notice.

items.label: Fundraiser verification status
items.description: Show who verified this fundraiser and when.

items.label: Fundraiser follow-up
items.description: Ask the OP for an update on this fundraiser, or report it to the modqueue.

items.label: Fundraiser tools settings
items.description: Turn features on or off and edit the wording, without leaving Reddit.

items.label: Edit bot messages
items.description: Edit every message the bot posts, including the saved verification notices.

items.label: Check the wiki log
items.description: Confirm the durable verification log exists and is readable by moderators only.

addModNote.label: Add a mod note on the OP when a fundraiser is verified

showVerifyingModInComment.label: Name the verifying moderator in the public comment (not recommended - mods then receive unsolicited DMs)

customNoticeText.label: Custom verification notice. Blank uses the built-in wording. Placeholders: {subreddit}, {date}, {mod}

messageTemplates.label: Saved notices a moderator can pick from. One per block separated by a line containing only ---. First line of each block is its name.

checklistItems.label: Verification checklist items, one per line. Blank uses the built-in list.

compactChecklist.label: Compact checklist: one tick-list instead of a row of toggles (shorter form, better on mobile)

fundraiserFlairText.label: Post flair that marks a fundraiser (blank = every post). Easier to set from the in-subreddit settings menu, which lists your actual flairs.

wikiLogEnabled.label: Keep a durable verification log on a subreddit wiki page (survives the app being uninstalled)

wikiLogPage.label: Wiki page for the verification log. Monthly pages are created underneath it.

modmailLogEnabled.label: Also post each verification to Mod Discussions

automodReplyEnabled.label: Reply to the OP when AutoModerator holds a fundraiser, listing the documents needed

automodReplyText.label: Custom intake wording. Blank uses the built-in text. Placeholders: {subreddit}, {op}

showAuthorSummary.label: Show the author's account age and karma on the verify form

duplicateDetectionEnabled.label: Detect repeated fundraiser links and report them to the modqueue

reportSameAuthorReposts.label: Also report when the same person reposts their own fundraiser link

sameAuthorRepostHours.label: Hours before the same person may repost their own fundraiser link. Match your subreddit rules. 0 = no waiting period; set very high (8760) if reposts are not allowed.

scanCommentsForLinks.label: Also scan comments for fundraiser links (much more traffic)

staleRemindersEnabled.label: Ask the OP for an update on old verified fundraisers

reminderDays.label: Days after verification before asking the OP for an update

graceDays.label: Days to wait for a reply before reporting the post to the modqueue

lockStalePosts.label: Also lock a stale fundraiser when reporting it

customReminderText.label: Custom reminder wording. Blank uses the built-in wording. Placeholders: {subreddit}, {op}, {days}, {grace}

minAccountAgeDays.label: Minimum account age in days (0 disables). Only annotates modqueue reports.

minKarma.label: Minimum combined karma (0 disables). Only annotates modqueue reports.
